prompt_record.text:
Use the attached accepted illustration as the STYLE anchor. Create a workflow-upscale conceptual vignette in the same quiet graphite hand-drawn linework, flat ivory fills with faint paper grain, small muted cyan/rose accents and warm amber light on a very light warm-grey background. Raised front three-quarter viewpoint.
Subject: one small square picture frame and one larger square detail frame, both holding the SAME simple geometric tile arrangement (three blocks and a curved line). The larger frame is simply larger, with the same shapes and equal line clarity, not magically repaired or beautified. Thin subtle parallel guide lines relate the small frame to the large frame. No quality rating, invented before/after improvement, pixel labels, numbers, arrows or controls.
4:3 landscape, subject compact and centred slightly above middle, lower third calm and empty for HTML caption. No text, letters, logos, watermark, UI, people or characters.

art_review.notes: Small and large frames contain matching geometric arrangements with similar clarity, but only the larger frame receives a gold sparkle and prominent overhead glow.
observations: The sparkle/lighting makes the larger result look rewarded or improved, creating a quality-win implication the catalog explicitly excludes.
Recommend removing the sparkle and balancing the lighting while keeping the same geometry, guide lines and equal clarity.
At 600x450 both arrangements are readable; there are no labels, arrows, ratings or controls. The larger frame is not merely a sharpened photograph.
Candidate 2 resolves the material refinement issue and is recommended instead. Candidate 1 is retained unchanged for traceability.
